en.errorBody: Something broke on this page. Try reloading it (your drinks are still saved).
en.invalidRequest: That request wasn't valid. Refresh and try again.
en.loadFailedBody: Something went wrong on our end. Your drinks are still saved, so just try again in a bit.
en.offline: You're offline. Reconnect and try again.
en.slowLoad: This is taking longer than usual.
en.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
en.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
en.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

zh.errorBody: 这个页面出了点问题。刷新一下再试试（你的记录都还在）。
zh.invalidRequest: 请求无效，请刷新后重试。
zh.loadFailedBody: 我们这边出了点问题。你的记录都还在，稍后再试一下就好。
zh.offline: 你目前处于离线状态。请连接网络后再试。
zh.somethingWentWrong: 出了点问题，请稍后再试。
zh.tooManyRequests: 请求过多，请稍等一分钟再试。
zh.unauthorized: 登录已失效，请重新登录。
